conjecture: n≡1(mod 3) produces longer trajectories than n≡2(mod 3)
failure_point: Signal direction unstable across disjoint ranges [1,5000] vs [5001,10000]
insight: mod 3 residue class ranking is not monotone across N. The signal appears noise-level. Odd/even (mod 2) is the stable structural predictor.
The simple log(3) term underestimates. The gap is c*log(~3.37), not c*log(3). First-order approximation is insufficient.

v_2(3n+1) and subsequent trajectory length are strongly correlated (large v_2 → smaller next value → shorter remaining trajectory). Independence assumption is invalid. Cannot decompose gap additively this way.

failure_point: R² < 0.05 for all models — underdetermined at n < 10^6
insight: Gap appears approximately constant (~12.3) but slow growth cannot be ruled out. log(3)+log(2)/6 fits coarse data but is unstable at fine grain. The constant c itself drifts with n, complicating all ratio-based derivations.
